issue.title: Windows Computer Use unavailable: nativePipe missing and SKY_CUA_NATIVE_PIPE_DIRECTORY not injected
issue.body: After updating Codex Desktop on Windows, Computer Use appears installed but the runtime does not inject SKY_CUA_NATIVE_PIPE_DIRECTORY. The local codex-computer-use.exe exists in the plugin cache, but nativePipe is missing and Computer Use cannot start. This looks like a plugin registry or bundled-plugin visibility mismatch rather than a missing install.

candidates.title: Windows Computer Use native pipe path missing after plugin update
candidates.body: Codex Desktop on Windows no longer passes SKY_CUA_NATIVE_PIPE_DIRECTORY to the Computer Use helper. The bundled C:\Program Files\WindowsApps\OpenAI.Codex_26.527.3686.0_x64__2p2nqsd0c76g0\app\resources\codex-computer-use.exe cannot start. Computer Use native pipe path is unavailable, nativePipe is undefined, and the app cannot launch Computer Use.

candidates.title: Windows Codex Desktop: node_repl / Computer Use fails with "windows sandbox failed: spawn setup refresh"
candidates.body: On Windows, node_repl and Browser tools fail before execution with windows sandbox failed: spawn setup refresh. Computer Use is installed, but the failure appears to happen in sandbox setup and permission refresh rather than the native pipe path.
